commentary.bulkers: Cao H have committed the Capesize "Lucky Carina" 177/2007 SWS, China (SS/DD 07/2027) to Chinese interests at high USD 23 mill. Note that a month ago, the one-year-older "Robusto" 173/2006 SWS, China (SS/DD 09/2026, Scrubber fitted) was sold at USD 19,5 mill basis delivery Q2 2026. The Kamsarmax "Nord Auriga" 81/2020 Jiangsu, China (SS 05/2030, DD 05/2028, Scrubber fitted) was committed at rgn USD 32 mill, while the "Aquavita Sea" 81/2020 Jiangsu, China (SS 01/2030, DD 11/2027) was committed at week ago at USD 30,5 mill. Moreover, the "Giewont" 79/2010 New Century, China (SS 01/2030, DD 12/2027) of Polska Zegluga Morska was committed at USD 11,7 mill. Remind you that back in November, the sister vessel "Ornak" 79/2010 New Century, China (SS 09/2030, DD 09/2028) was sold at USD 11,35 mill. On the Supramax sector, Mykonos Shipping committed the "Kapta Mathios" 58/2009 Tsuneishi Zhoushan, China (SS/DD 11/2026) to Chinese interests at USD 13,75 mill. For reference, the sister vessel "Vita Harmony" 58/2009 Tsuneishi Zhoushan, China (SS 02/2029, DD 03/2027) was sold back in October at the same price. Furthermore, Thalkat Shipping committed the "Theodora" 53/2008 Iwagi, Japan (SS 12/2030, DD 02/2029) at USD 13 mill. Note that the one-year-older sister vessel "Evriali" 53/2007 Iwagi, Japan (SS 09/2027, DD 11/2025) was sold in November at USD 10,5 mill. Swire & Sons have committed the Handysize "Hunan" 39/2016 Chengxi, China (SS/DD 04/2026) at USD 19 mill. Remind you that same owners committed the "Powan" 39/2016 Zhejiang, China (SS/DD 05/2026) a month ago at USD 19 mill also.
commentary.tankers: Following the sale of the LR2 "STI Kingsway" 110/2015 Sungdong, Korea (SS 08/2030, DD 06/2028, Scrubber fitted) in January at USD 57,5 mill, clients of Scorpio Tankers have now committed the sister vessel "STI Solidarity" 110/2015 Sungdong, Korea (SS 11/2030, DD 09/2028, Scrubber fitted) at USD 60 mill. Nord Group committed the Aframax "Nordsymphony" 106/2008 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS/DD 04/2027) at USD 33,5 mill. Note that a couple of months ago, the sister vessel "Ark" 105/2008 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS 01/2028, DD 05/2026) was sold at USD 27 mill. In addition, the one-year-older "Volta River" 105/2007 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS/DD 08/2027) was committed to undisclosed interests at USD 33 mill. More sales from Scorpio Tankers, the MR2s "STI Osceola" & "STI Seneca" 50/2015 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS 04/2030, DD 04/2028 & SS 06/2030, DD 06/2028, Scrubber fitted) were committed at USD 35 mill each. Remind you that three months ago, the "LVM Warrior" 50/2015 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS 01/2030, DD 03/2028, Scrubber fitted) was sold at USD 33,3 mill.

freight.Capesize: Iron ore rates on the West Australia / China route continued throughout
freight.Kamsarmax / Panamax: North Pacific rounds ranged at the usd 19,000/21,000 pd. A number of Australian trips into China were reported at the level of usd 19,000/22,000 pd. Australian trips into India were reported at the level of usd 19,000/21,000 pd. China trips via Indonesia into China were fixed around usd 15,000/18,000 pd. India trips via East Coast South America into Continent-Mediterranean were reported around usd 20,000/22,000 pd. Mediterranean trips via North Coast South America into China were fixed in a range of usd 25,000/27,000 pd. Additionally, East Coast South American trips into China were fixed around usd 18,000 pd plus ballast bonus at the usd 800k. East Coast South American trips into Mediterranean were fixed around usd 25,000/26,000 pd. On the period front, a Kamsarmax was reported fixed in the usd 20,000 pd for 1 year employment basis delivery East Coast India.
freight.Ultramax / Supramax: Indonesia trips into China ranged at the usd 14,000/16,000 pd. A number of South East Asia trips into West Coast Central America were reported at the level of usd 16,000/18,000 pd. Continental trips into East Africa were fixed at the level of usd 30,000/32,000 pd.
freight.Handymax / Handysize: Trips from West Africa via East Coast South America into US Gulf were fixed around usd 14,000/16,000 pd. Intercontinental trips were reported at the level of usd 13,000/15,000 pd. East Coast South American trips into West Coast South America were reported around usd 24,000/27,000 pd.
